decision: Below 30rem (480px) every sized modal (.dlg, .kbdsheet) fills the viewport with no radius, as in @atlaskit/modal-dialog. 30rem and wider is unchanged.
method: Chromium, app shell. Each dialog is forced open by showing its backdrop as flex and hiding sibling dialogs; dialogs were not opened from their triggers and carry no data. States: 390x844 LTR, RTL and --ui-scale 1.25, 479x844, 480x844, 768x1024 and 1440x900.
